assertions.name: transition_is_not_hyperbolic
assertions.source: Hopf link complement is solid torus, Vol=0

description: Probes the meson analogue of the lepton mass-ratio derivation. Key finding: the meson transition element (σ₁²) closes to the Hopf link (Vol=0, not hyperbolic), so hyperbolic volume CANNOT give the meson ratio. The meson sector requires an algebraic (Hecke trace at finite q₀) formula, not a geometric one.

data.key_finding: meson transition is Hopf link (Vol=0), not hyperbolic
